[Verse 1]
[Em]The other night
I had a dream
[D]There was a world full of
kings and queens
[C]But it was cold
Dark as the night
[Em]We were the fire on the
moonlit skies
[Em]We weren't divided
We were the same
[D]And we were free But we
all wore chains
[C]We couldn't see it
But we created
[Em]A place between truth and
overrated If I could
[Em]just see it all Just like a
fly on the wall Would I be
[D]able to accept what I
can't control? And would I
[C]share what I saw? Or just sit
back and ignore Like
[Em]nothing never happened, I haven't
seen you before?

[Pre-Chorus]
[G]I'm on the run from a
thief I let in-
[Em]to my head
I know,
[G]I hold the keys, so
don't be scared When I
[Em]turn and shout:

[Chorus]
[C]I don't think I need
[D]you anymore
[G]Take your words, and your lies
[Em]and just beat it!
[C]I don't think I need
[D]you anymore
[G]Take the hurt and the pain,
[Em]I don't need it!
[C]I wanna live, I wanna
[D]be the change
[G]We can all be
[Em]kings and queens
[C]If we can just learn
[D]to believe
[G]If we can just learn
[Em]to believe

[Interlude]
[C]

[Verse 2]
[Em]We had a plan
to build a wall
[D]A great divide that would
never fall
[C]To separate us
From all the pain
[Em]And keep our skeletons
locked away And
[Em]brick by brick We built
it so thick That it
[D]blacked out the sky and all
the sunlight And
[C]one by one We all
became numb We were
[Em]making the bullets to a
broken gun If I could
[Em]just see it all Just like a
fly on the wall Would I be
[D]able to accept what I
can't control? And would I
[C]share what I saw? Or just sit
back and ignore Like
[Em]nothing never happened, I haven't
seen you before?
